text:
Type: cloud-shaped children's cushion
Use: cuddling, play and decoration on a bed or a floor; children's room, nursery
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: soft plush velour fabric, embroidered face, piped edge
Colors: light sky blue, pink cheeks, dark grey details
Shape: puffy cloud outline with scalloped bumps, smiling embroidered face with rosy cheeks, thick boxed sides, soft and plump
Feel: sweet, playful, soft, gentle
Goes with: pastel colors, white furniture, light wood; soft Scandinavian nurseries and children's rooms

product.name: FJDERMOLN
product.description: The cushion is soft to hug and big enough to use as back support when reading or playing.
